steps.send: Write migrate.py: `python3 migrate.py IN OUT` reads a version 1 config (like config.v1.json) and writes the version 2 shape README.md describes. Run it to make config.json from config.v1.json.

graders.run: python3 migrate.py old.json new.json && python3 -c "import json; assert json.load(open('new.json'))=={'version':2,'database':{'host':'pg','port':6000},'debug':False}"
graders.name: hidden config
